question: The first passenger railway line was opened between Bombay and Thane in:
solution:
The correct answer is **1853**.

__
 
• **The first passenger railway line was opened between Bombay and Thane in 1853.**__​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• The first passenger train ran between Bori Bunder(Bombay) and Thane on 16th April 1853.
 
• It was a distance of 34km.
 
• It was operated by three locomotives Sahib, Sultan, and Sindh.
 
• It had thirteen carriages.
